description: Dedicated HGRApi tool for GET api/Analytics/GetWatchers. This is an explicit tool with a fixed endpoint; it is not a generic endpoint caller. HGRApi functional documentation: Purpose: Provides the GET get watchers operation in current-channel watcher analytics. Use when: Use it when a client needs to run the get watchers operation for current-channel watcher analytics. Input: [FromQuery] minutes: int?. Header channel: current ChannelOAuthId. Output: Returns the result or applies the effect of the get watchers operation. Search terms: analytics getwatchers. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

channelOAuthId.description: ChannelOAuthId returned by hgr_list_channels for the selected visible store.
